articles.title: INS Trishul arrives in Italy, conducts joint exercise with Italian Navy warship
articles.description: New Delhi, Oct 26. Indian Navy warship INS Trishul arrived at Civitavecchia, Italy, on October 25 as part of its ongoing operational deployment to the Mediterranean Sea, reinforcing maritime cooperation between the Indian and Italian navies. Before entering the harbour, INS Trishul conducted a Passage Exercise (PASSEX) with Italian Navy ship Carlo Margottini.
